explain.planHint: The steps, and what each index crossed out before a granule was read.
explain.estimateHint: What running this would read: parts, rows and marks per table.
explain.pipelineHint: The processors that carry the rows, and how many threads each gets.
explain.syntaxHint: The query as the optimizer rewrote it.
explain.queryTreeHint: The analyzer's own reading of the query, resolved to column ids and types.

replicasDenied: This server has {replicas} replicas and this user may not read across them (it needs the READ ON REMOTE grant), so only the replica that answered is shown.
replicasFailed: This server has {replicas} replicas and reading across them failed, so only the replica that answered is shown. {message}

insert.cannotWrite: Cannot write {value} to a database column.
insert.unsupportedType: Unsupported value type {type} in a row batch.
insert.rowWidth: Row has {values} values but the batch has {columns} columns.
insert.keyMissing: The key {key} is not among the columns being written.
insert.noUpsert: {engine} cannot update and insert in one statement, so this flow cannot upsert into it.
